description: Get the full exact text of one article, with its paragraphs, official link, version date and the previous and next article. Use it to check deadlines, amounts and ages before stating them. Pass as_of (a date) for the newest matsne version dated on or before that day; its changes may have taken effect later, so give the version date. ერთი მუხლის სრული ზუსტი ტექსტი, ოფიციალური ბმული და რედაქციის თარიღი; as_of თარიღით მიიღებ იმ დღემდე ბოლო რედაქციას.

article.description: Article number as printed, e.g. 369, 48 or 166¹ (166-1 also works). A paragraph goes in its own argument. Check that article_number in the reply is the one you asked for.
article.title: Article

as_of.description: Optional date as YYYY-MM-DD: return the newest matsne version dated on or before that day instead of the current one (its changes may have taken effect later).
as_of.title: As Of

code.description: Code id from list_codes (e.g. civil_code, labour_code) or its Georgian name (e.g. შრომის კოდექსი).
code.title: Code

name: get_article

as_of.description: Set when an earlier date was asked for: the text is the wording of the consolidated version matsne dates on or before this day, and version_date and source_url are those of that version.
as_of.title: As Of

history_note.description: What to tell the person about an earlier-date answer.
history_note.title: History Note

in_force_since.description: Date this article's current wording took effect, if known.
in_force_since.title: In Force Since

notice.default: ეს არის კანონის ტექსტი და წყარო, არა იურიდიული კონსულტაცია. ოფიციალური ტექსტი: matsne.gov.ge. This is law text and its source, not legal advice. The official text is on matsne.gov.ge; for important decisions consult a lawyer.
notice.title: Notice

replaced_on.description: Date of the later version that changed or removed this wording; absent when it is still the current one.
replaced_on.title: Replaced On

source_url.description: Official matsne.gov.ge link for this text.
source_url.title: Source Url

text.description: Full stored text of the article, unaltered.
text.title: Text

version_date.description: Date of the consolidated version this text comes from.
version_date.title: Version Date

version_note.description: Present when a version date is unknown or text may be incomplete.
version_note.title: Version Note

wording_from.description: Date of the version that introduced this wording; absent when it is older than the stored history.
wording_from.title: Wording From

data_current_as_of.description: Date (ISO) the stored law texts were last confirmed against matsne.gov.ge. Tell the person this date.
data_current_as_of.title: Data Current As Of

freshness_warning.description: Set when that check is overdue or its date is unknown; pass the warning on with the answer.
freshness_warning.title: Freshness Warning
